name: Subordination, non-disturbance and attornment agreement
what: An agreement among lender, tenant and landlord that ranks the lease behind the loan while protecting the tenant if the lender forecloses.

fields.label: Lender
fields.definition: The lender the agreement protects, and whether its successors and any buyer at foreclosure are covered.

fields.label: Tenant
fields.definition: The tenant that signed, by legal name.

fields.label: Landlord
fields.definition: The landlord and borrower that signed or consented.

fields.label: Agreement date
fields.definition: The date of the agreement, read from its first page or the last signature.

fields.label: Lease identified
fields.definition: The lease and amendments the agreement names by date; compare them with the lease file.

fields.label: Loan identified
fields.definition: The deed of trust or mortgage the lease is subordinated to, by date, amount and recording information if given.

fields.label: Subordination
fields.definition: What the lease becomes subordinate to, including whether renewals, increases and replacements of the loan are covered.

fields.label: Non-disturbance
fields.definition: The lender's promise not to end the lease or disturb the tenant at foreclosure, and the conditions on it, usually that the tenant is not in default past any cure period.

fields.label: Attornment
fields.definition: The tenant's promise to recognize the lender or a foreclosure buyer as landlord, and when it takes effect.

fields.label: What a successor is not bound by
fields.definition: The listed exceptions for a successor landlord, such as rent paid far in advance, offsets for a prior landlord's defaults, amendments made without the lender's consent, or unpaid allowances.

fields.label: Lender notice and cure right
fields.definition: Whether the tenant must notify the lender of a landlord default before ending the lease or offsetting rent, and how long the lender then has to cure.

fields.label: Treatment of purchase options
fields.definition: How the agreement treats any tenant purchase option or first refusal right at foreclosure; null if the agreement is silent.

fields.label: Recording
fields.definition: The county recording number and date if the agreement was recorded, or a note that it was not.
